tech.title: Array Extension
tech.effect: The array grows. The reply is still on its way.

missions.title: Beyond Humanity
missions.duty_text: Finish your station duty at the overlook.

optional.fact: Light from the nearest stars left years before you looked up.

learn: Light takes years to cross space.

team.note: Light is still on its way.

emergency_script.speaker: samira_shah
emergency_script.text: Easy. We are not in a rush. Retry.

emergency_script.speaker: mira_vale
emergency_script.text: Recovery is open. Do the critical step again. The shift is not over.

astronaut.title: Walk the Array Line
astronaut.science: A big array is a long walk. Take care and enjoy the view.
astronaut.hint: Visit both dish markers, then reach the goal.

emergency.warning: You stepped onto a hazard. Back out and plot again.

engineer.rule: Flag every dish off by more than 0.1 degrees.
engineer.title: Dish Alignment
engineer.science: Many dishes work as one only when they all point the same way.
engineer.hint: Read each dish and flag the one that is off.
engineer.mistake: Missed or wrongly flagged a dish.

emergency.warning: A dish was missed. Inspect again.

parts.prompt: Earliest year a reply could arrive (round trip)

physicist.title: Light Lag
physicist.science: Light takes years to cross space. A reply from a far star is a long wait.
physicist.hint: A round trip is twice the distance in light years. Add it to 2030.
physicist.mistake: Entered a reply year outside tolerance.

emergency.warning: The lag does not add up. Recompute.

parts.prompt: Signal gain compared to one dish (times)

mathematician.title: Array Gain
mathematician.science: More collecting area means more signal. Four dishes collect four times as much.
mathematician.hint: Multiply dishes by area. Gain is the ratio to one dish.

emergency.warning: The gain does not add up. Fix the arithmetic.

biologist.question: Which view matches ID card D-1: round cells?

conclusions.text: Healthy soil bacteria. The dome garden is fine.
Soil is dead. Replace it all.

biologist.title: Dome Garden Soil
biologist.science: Healthy soil is full of tiny helpers that feed the plants.
biologist.hint: Sterilize first. Then match the view.

emergency.warning: The scoop was not sterile. Clean it and collect again.

patients.name: Crew B
patients.note: Keeps checking the dish for a reply.

actions.label: Rest, talk it over, and take a walk
actions.effect: A calm night helps the whole team.

actions.label: Watch the dish all night
actions.effect: A tired watch is not a good watch.

medical.title: The Waiting Game
medical.science: Waiting is hard on the mind. Rest and company help.
medical.mistake: Treated before scanning every crew member.

emergency.warning: Treatment began before the scan finished. Stabilize and scan again.

comms.rule: Call GO when the reading is 4 of 5 or better. Call HOLD for lower.
comms.title: Quiet Listening
comms.science: Listening takes patience. The quieter the line, the better the chance of hearing something faint.
comms.hint: Read each channel against the rule.
comms.mistake: Gave the wrong call on a channel.

emergency.warning: A noisy channel was called GO. Poll again.

director.prompt: The reply has not arrived. Light takes years. How should the team spend the next year?

choices.text: Keep listening and keep the array in good shape.
choices.consequence: Patience pays off. The team stays steady.

choices.text: Add two dishes to hear fainter signals.
choices.consequence: The array gets better, and the work takes the whole year.

choices.text: Send a second message today to speed things up.
choices.consequence: A second message does not make light go faster.

director.title: Beyond Humanity
director.science: Some questions take many years to answer. Good teams stay curious and patient.
director.hint: Pick the answer a patient team would choose.
director.mistake: Chose to send another message instead of waiting.

emergency.warning: A message went out without a plan. Open the review.
